20+ Seasonal Beers at JTAPS: Your Guide to Our Rotating Selection

January 30, 2026 JTAPS Team Beer & Drinks

More Than Just Cold Beer: A Craft Beer Experience

At JTAPS Bar and Grill, we know that great food deserves great beer. That's why we've invested in building one of Cincinnati's most impressive seasonal beer selections—with over 20 taps featuring rotating craft brews that change with the seasons.

Whether you're a beer connoisseur looking for the next rare find, a casual fan wanting to try something new, or someone who just wants a cold one while watching the game, our beer program has something for you.

Why Seasonal Beers Matter

Seasonal beers are more than just marketing. They're a celebration of craftsmanship, local brewing traditions, and the spirit of discovery. Each season brings unique flavors that complement the weather and the mood.

  • Spring: Light, refreshing pale ales and wheats that shake off winter
  • Summer: Crisp lagers and citrusy IPAs perfect for warm game days
  • Fall: Rich amber ales and pumpkin spice brews that embrace the harvest
  • Winter: Bold stouts, porters, and warming spiced ales

By rotating our seasonal selection, we ensure that there's always something new and exciting to discover at JTAPS.

Our Beer Selection Philosophy

When curating our 20+ taps, we follow a simple philosophy: quality over quantity, and variety over repetition.

Here's what guides our beer selection:

  • Local First: We prioritize Cincinnati and Ohio breweries. Supporting local keeps our community vibrant and gives you authentic local flavor
  • Quality Craft: We partner with breweries that care about their craft—no mass-produced, flavorless beers on our taps
  • Diversity: Our selection spans styles and ABVs, ensuring everyone finds something they love
  • Seasonal Rotation: We change our selection regularly, so repeat visitors always have something new to try
  • Customer Input: We listen to what our guests want and adjust accordingly

Cincinnati's Craft Beer Scene

Cincinnati has an incredible brewing heritage dating back to the 1800s, and today's craft beer scene is thriving. We're proud to showcase local breweries like:

  • MadTree Brewing: Cincinnati's flagship modern craft brewery with bold, experimental brews
  • Rhinegeist: Known for their West Coast-style IPAs and approachable ales
  • Fifty West Brewing: Craft beers inspired by Cincinnati's brewing heritage
  • Urban Artifact: Experimental and sour beers that push boundaries
  • Fretboard Brewing: Music-inspired brews with personality
  • The Silo Brewing Company: Premium craft beers with Ohio pride

When you drink at JTAPS, you're supporting Cincinnati's beer community and tasting beers made with care by local brewers who live and work here.

What's Currently on Tap

Our current rotation includes a mix of:

Year-Round Favorites:

  • Classic lagers and pilsners for the traditional beer drinker
  • Reliable IPAs and pale ales for hop enthusiasts
  • Smooth stouts and porters for rich, complex flavors

Seasonal Specials:

  • Limited releases from Cincinnati breweries
  • Nationally acclaimed seasonal brews
  • Experimental and rare finds for adventurous palates

Light Options:

  • Low-ABV session beers
  • Non-alcoholic craft options
  • Hard seltzers and other beverages

Pro tip: Ask our staff what's new! Our bartenders are knowledgeable about every beer on tap and can recommend the perfect pairing for your mood, meal, or the game you're watching.

Beer Pairings with JTAPS Menu

Great beer isn't just about the beer—it's about pairing it with great food. Here are some of our favorite JTAPS beer and food combinations:

Wings + Beer Pairings:

  • Pete's Sauce Wings + Crisp Lager: The citrus notes cut through the richness
  • Buffalo Wings + IPA: Hop bitterness meets heat in a beautiful dance
  • Garlic Parmesan Wings + Wheat Beer: The creamy, garlicky sauce pairs perfectly with wheat's smoothness
  • BBQ Wings + Amber Ale: Smoky and sweet complement each other

Gyros + Beer Pairings:

  • Traditional Lamb Gyro + Märzen/Oktoberfest: A match made in beer heaven
  • Chicken Gyro + Light Lager: Fresh and refreshing
  • Gyro Melt + Porter: Rich and satisfying

Burgers + Beer Pairings:

  • Classic Cheeseburger + Pilsner: A timeless pairing
  • Gourmet Burger + IPA: Bold flavors deserve bold beer

Game Day + Beer Day = Perfect Day

There's nothing like watching the game with a cold beer in your hand and great company around you. At JTAPS, we combine:

  • 50+ HD TVs for every game
  • 20+ seasonal beers on tap
  • Famous wings and great food
  • An electric, passionate crowd of fans
  • Cold beer selection and knowledgeable bartenders

It's the complete package. Whether you're catching an NFL Sunday, college football playoff, World Series, Stanley Cup Finals, or March Madness, you'll have the perfect beer in your hand.

Try Before You Commit: Sample Flights

Not sure what you want? Ask about our beer flights! We can put together a flight of 4-5 different beers so you can sample and discover your new favorite without committing to a full pint.

This is a great way to:

  • Explore new breweries and styles
  • Find beers you might not have tried alone
  • Compare seasonal offerings side by side
  • Educate your palate and expand your beer knowledge

Special Beer Events at JTAPS

Throughout the year, we host special beer events and tap takeovers:

  • Seasonal Release Parties: When breweries release limited edition beers, we celebrate
  • Brewery Nights: Meet brewers, learn their stories, and taste exclusive pours
  • Beer & Food Pairings: Special events where beers are paired with menu items
  • Happy Hour Specials: Rotating beer discounts throughout the week

Follow us on social media or call (513) 574-9777 to stay updated on upcoming beer events!

The JTAPS Beer Philosophy

At the end of the day, our beer program is about one thing: creating great experiences. A great beer in the right moment with the right company makes memories. That's what we're here for.

We don't just serve beer. We serve discovery, community, craftsmanship, and the joy of finding that perfect brew that hits just right on game day.

Ready to Explore?

Whether you're a beer expert or just getting started, we invite you to visit JTAPS and explore our 20+ seasonal beer selection. Our bartenders are here to guide you, our food is ready to pair perfectly, and our atmosphere is perfect for enjoying every sip.

Stop by for happy hour, game day, or just a Friday night with friends. You'll leave with a great memory and probably a new favorite beer.
